comparison.objective: Stack crates largest-first, versus commission an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Size ordering, grasping, transport, and stable stacking versus fine tool use, controlled rotary adjustment, counterholding, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: A stable size-ordered stack is title-implied; no body/specs, dimensions, stability time, or damage rubric is present. Candidate requires two non-bottoming stops and retained lock.
comparison.reason: Ordered stacking tests packing and stability, not mechanical calibration.
